title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification (Fourth Revision)

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 1786 specifies requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires (TMT bars) produced by the thermo-mechanical treatment process for use as reinforcement in concrete. ISI certification is MANDATORY for TMT bars/steel reinforcement sold in India.

clauses.title: Grades and Properties
clauses.text:
TMT bar grades under IS 1786:
- Fe 415: Yield strength ≥415 MPa, Elongation ≥14.5%. Most common for residential construction.
- Fe 415D: Ductile variant of Fe 415 with higher elongation (≥18%). Recommended for earthquake-prone zones.
- Fe 500: Yield strength ≥500 MPa, Elongation ≥12%. For commercial and industrial structures.
- Fe 500D: Ductile variant with elongation ≥16%. Preferred for seismic zones.
- Fe 550: Yield ≥550 MPa. For heavy infrastructure.
- Fe 600: Yield ≥600 MPa. For pre-stressed concrete and specialized applications.
- Carbon content: Max 0.30% for Fe 415, Max 0.25% for Fe 500D
- All TMT bars must bear the ISI mark (CM/L number) for legal sale in India.
